login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use the handle for your account.
login.factorEmail: Sent to the email on your account.
login.passkeyUnsupported: This browser does not support passkeys.
login.passkeyNeedsHandle: Enter your handle first, so your server can be found.
login.errorHandleEmail: Sign in with your handle, not your email
login.detectFailed: Could not detect a server for that handle yet. Pick one above if you know it.

signup.title: Create account
signup.placement: The server places your repository; your handle works across the whole namespace either way.

security.title: Two-factor authentication
security.pendingTitle: Setup was started but not finished
security.pendingBody: The secret is shown once and the server never returns it again, so the code below cannot be displayed a second time. Enter the code from your authenticator if you already scanned it, or start again for a fresh one.
security.subtitle: A code from your authenticator, on top of your password.
security.notImplementedAfter: Two-factor is a server feature rather than part of the atproto lexicon, so it is only available where the PDS offers it.
security.scanThis: Scan this with your authenticator, then enter the code it shows.
security.orSecret: Or enter this secret by hand
security.startAgainBody: Replaces the pending secret with a new one. Nothing is enabled until you confirm it, so this cannot lock you out.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.unsupported: This browser does not support passkeys.
passkeys.errorRemovePassword: Enter your password to remove a passkey
passkeys.subtitle: Sign in with your device instead of a password.
passkeys.notImplementedAfter: Like two-factor, passkeys are a server feature rather than part of the atproto lexicon.

appPasswords.title: App passwords
appPasswords.copyOnce: Copy this now — it is shown once
appPasswords.subtitle: For clients that sign in with a password instead of OAuth.

account.title: Account
account.exportBody: Your repository as a CAR file, straight from the PDS that holds it.
account.deactivateNote: Deactivating or deleting an account is done from the server that hosts it.

invites.title: Invite codes
invites.subtitle: Codes issued to your account by this server.
invites.none: This server has issued no invite codes to your account.

settings.serverSubtitle: Every request goes to this server.
settings.overrideNote: Choosing a server here overrides the one detected from your handle. Sign in again to let detection pick it for you.
